title: Autonomy Register — Section D: Foundation Model Dependency Fields
description: Section D of the Autonomy Register entry, as specified in STD-EDS-007.

foundation_model_dependency.description: Values: Yes │ Partial │ No. Yes = system behaviour materially determined by a foundation model not trained or fine-tuned by the organisation. Partial = fine-tuned derivative. No = fully internally trained or rule-based. Default: No. (Source of truth: CAIO)

foundation_model_identifier.description: [Mandatory where dependency = Yes or Partial] Format: [Provider name] — [Model name/version/API endpoint]. Null where dependency = No. (Source of truth: CAIO)

foundation_model_opacity_rating.description: [Mandatory where dependency = Yes or Partial] Values: Documented │ Partial │ Opaque. Documented = provider publishes training data summary, capability evaluations, and known limitations. Partial = provider publishes some but not all. Opaque = provider publishes none. Assessed by CAIO using available provider disclosures and independent evaluations. Null where dependency = No. (Source of truth: CAIO)

characterisation_assessment_date.description: [Mandatory where dependency = Yes or Partial] Must be within 12 months. Must be updated within 30 days of any confirmed provider model update. Triggers non-compliance flag when overdue. Null where dependency = No. (Source of truth: CAIO)

behavioural_boundary_ref.description: [Mandatory where dependency = Yes or Partial] Format: BBP-YYYY-NNN. References the behavioural boundary parameter specification document per STD-EDS-003 §11.3. Null where dependency = No. (Source of truth: CAIO)

provider_change_monitoring_status.description: [Mandatory where dependency = Yes or Partial] Values: Active │ Lapsed │ Not_applicable. Active = confirmed mechanism for receiving or detecting provider model update notifications is operational. Lapsed = mechanism existed but is no longer confirmed active. Not_applicable = dependency = No. (Source of truth: CAIO)
